literal_source_claim: The cardinality of the power set of every set is strictly greater than the cardinality of the set.
canonical_claim: For every set A, the cardinality of A is strictly less than the cardinality of its power set P(A).

canonical_formal_target.declaration_or_expression: Stage1.THM_M_0767.CanonicalTarget := forall (alpha : Type u) (s : Set alpha), Cardinal.mk s < Cardinal.mk (Set.powerset s)

domain_and_universes: One arbitrary alpha : Type u and s : Set alpha, represented by its subtype; the powerset is the subtype Set.powerset s and both cardinals inhabit Cardinal.{u}, requiring no lift.

alternate_encodings.target: type-level alpha versus Set alpha and set-level subtype s versus the subtype of Set.powerset s
there is no surjection A -> P(A)
alternate_encodings.relationship: supporting diagonal form, not yet credited as an iff
alternate_encodings.checked_witness: open: cardinal-order conversion and foundation requirements must be checked

excluded_degenerate_cases: None: the empty set and all finite and infinite sets remain in scope.
foundation_profile: The exact proof wrapper reports exactly propext, Classical.choice, and Quot.sound; transitive trust acceptance remains downstream.
tcb_profile: Lean kernel 4.29.0 and pinned mathlib are the intended base; exact import and transitive declaration closure remain open
computation_profile: No computation, oracle, experiment, or unchecked certificate is credited; the theorem is a noncomputational cardinality result
